title: Frustration without Glass: A Non-Abelian Gauge Model of Network Compatibility
summary: We formulate a non-Abelian theory of network compatibility in which dynamical transformations reside on the links. Gauge covariance follows from the freedom to choose local representation frames, while plaquette holonomies quantify the incompatibility of closed-loop transformations. For an SU(2) model on the complete simplicial 2-complex with quenched random plaquette couplings, parallel-tempering simulations reveal a continuous disorder-driven phase transition characterized by the network compatibility $M_P$.
